primitives.verbatim_quote: `wilsonInterval(10,10).high === 0.9999999999999999`, left as-is.** Math correct, computed a ULP short; `clamp01` cannot round it up.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'n': 'number of trials (dimensionless)', 'k': 'number of successes (dimensionless)', 'high': 'upper bound of Wilson interval (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Floating-point arithmetic introduces ULP-level rounding errors; clamp01 prevents upward rounding.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When rate <= high fails at k = n due to floating-point precision loss.

primitives.breakdown_regime: When a kill line is written after its run but before the gate's full clone scan.
